That is "非法倒卖车票" which in Chinese law is "非法倒卖车票罪" under "非法经营" maybe? Actually Chinese criminal law has a specific offense: "非法倒卖车票罪" (illegal ticket scalping) under Article 225 of Criminal Law (illegal business). The charge name might be "非法经营". Could be considered "非法获取公民个人信息". However the primary crime is illegal ticket resale.

Thus answer: [罪名]非法经营<eoa>
